title: Warranty Claim Tracking Log
subtitle: Automotive Warranty Claim: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Warranty Claim Tracking Log covers vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file. The warranty claim coordinator records Automotive Warranty Claim events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Warranty Claim Tracking Log keeps Automotive Warranty Claim exceptions visible until the warranty claim coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Warranty Claim Tracking Log at service facility, diagnostic bay, records system, and retained-parts area. Document vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file identity before Automotive Warranty Claim begins. Compare vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file findings with stated Automotive Warranty Claim criteria; route unresolved Automotive Warranty Claim issues to authorized warranty reviewer. For Warranty Claim Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Automotive Warranty Claim. Ask authorized warranty reviewer to review Automotive Warranty Claim conditions beyond the warranty claim coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking variance reference and responsible owner
sections.guidance: For Automotive Warranty Claim, identify responsible parties, service facility, diagnostic bay, records system, and retained-parts area, and the linked vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file source.

fields.label: Claim, repair order, customer, and contract
VIN, mileage, in-service date, and coverage reference
Component, part, serial, prior repair, and failure code

sections.title: Status events and next-control history
sections.guidance: Capture Automotive Warranty Claim facts for vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Automotive Warranty Claim tracked controls
items: Maintenance, modification, misuse, and prior-repair evidence
Repair estimate, part disposition, and authorization
Approval, denial, additional-information, and appeal route

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: Keep the Automotive Warranty Claim chronology intact through handoff. State the unresolved exception, the owner selected by Warranty Claim Coordinator, and the next control point.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Required evidence or retained part missing
blocks.guidance: Pause Automotive Warranty Claim when eligibility, diagnosis, evidence, part retention, repair authority, or coverage decision remains unresolved. Retain the available Automotive Warranty Claim proof and route unresolved vehicle, covered component allegation, symptom chronology, diagnosis, repair history, evidence, and coverage decision file scope to warranty claim coordinator.
